description: This file defines the ScssHelper class in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to compile SCSS to CSS, manipulate colors (darken, lighten, rgba), and validate color strings. It serves as a utility for handling SCSS-related operations, particularly color adjustments.

classes.name: ScssHelper
classes.description: A utility class to handle SCSS compilation and color manipulations such as darkening, lightening, and RGBA conversion, utilizing the ScssPhp library.

methods.name: getNewCompiler
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new SCSS compiler instance configured with compressed output style.

methods.name: darken
methods.description: Darkens the given color by the specified amount using SCSS functions.

methods.name: lighten
methods.description: Lightens the given color by the specified amount using SCSS functions.

methods.name: rgba
methods.description: Converts a color to RGBA format with the specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: isValidColor
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper color value recognized by SCSS.
